Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293286 (Polyadenylate-binding protein 1). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all matching activity rows without deduplication. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
